answer: Each identity locks collateral in a vault; evidence of correlated equivocation links the signers, making pairwise violations across k coordinated identities incur O(k²) aggregate slashing. On detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss makes a sybil swarm costlier than one operator split into names. Asymmetric depreciation slows replenishment, leaving liabilities to accumulate along a ridge rather than disappear with a walnut-sized deposit.
